question.text: The correct statement about the synthesis of erythritol <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> used in the preparation of PETN is

options.text: The synthesis requires three aldol condensations and one Cannizzaro reaction.
Alpha hydrogen of ethanol and methanol are involved in this reaction.
The synthesis requires two aldol condensation and two Cannizzaro reactions.
The synthesis requires four aldol condensations between methanol and ethanol.

solution.text: The first three steps are Aldol condensations followed by one Cannizzaro reaction step in presence of base. In final step a salt of formic acid will also be formed as side product.
